capabilities: Chat with vault notes in a sidebar panel
Reference notes with @ and search the vault
Insert or replace selected text with model output
Run scheduled prompts and bulk note updates
extras: Free edition covers chat, note references, search and editor insert/replace; scheduled tasks, bulk note updates and SMTP notifications need a maintainer-issued activation code verified offline with an Ed25519 key. Scheduled tasks only run while Obsidian and the plugin stay open. Source lives in a private repository; only build artifacts are public.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send note content to a local AI agent, apply its answers back into notes, or run prompts on a schedule.

relations.evidence: Use OpenCode in the Obsidian desktop sidebar to chat with vault notes
